contributorUsability.docsOnly: Docs-only: give a concrete reason runtime provisioning does not apply. Only documentation-file diffs qualify, regardless of PR title; do not claim an unperformed clean-install check.

clauses.label: Consumers
clauses.prompt: Name the consumers and supported platforms (Windows and Linux, or an explicit Windows-only/Linux-only scope).
clauses.failure: Named consumers or supported platforms are missing or vague.

clauses.label: Setup
clauses.prompt: Describe public setup/configuration and prerequisites; link the user documentation and any single-platform limitation.
clauses.failure: Public setup/prerequisites and user documentation are missing.

clauses.label: Validation
clauses.prompt: Record clean temporary-home or hermetic-fixture validation, exact commands in backticks, and numeric results for each supported platform.
clauses.failure: Clean/hermetic validation commands and numeric results are missing.

clauses.label: Private prerequisites
clauses.prompt: State 'none'. No author-private skills, personal paths, or preseeded databases may be required; path redaction alone is not reuse.
clauses.failure: No-private-prerequisites declaration is absent or author-machine-only dependencies are stated.

platforms.failure: Portable claims need Windows and Linux execution evidence; single-platform scope needs documented limitations.
platforms.remediation: Supply platform-labelled command/results for Windows and Linux, or declare Windows only/Linux only and document that limitation in Setup.
